d:
Bharat ke videsh mantri es jayshankar ne azarbaijan ke baku sthit ateshgah agni mandir ka daura kiya. is mandir men devnagri men likhe abhilekh, bhagvan ganesh aur jvala ji ka ullekh milta hai. janie, kya hai is aitihasik mandir ka bharat se rishta aur kaise yah bhartiy vyapariyon aur tirthayatriyon ka aham kendr bana.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
